description: Current v1 ZENV control subjects and JSON media types.

subjects.subject: zap.capability.query
subjects.purpose: Ask a peer for advertised capabilities and grants.

subjects.subject: zap.capability.response
subjects.purpose: Return a signed peer capability advertisement.

subjects.subject: zap.poa.validator_set.request
subjects.purpose: Request a signed versioned PoA validator set from a peer.

subjects.subject: zap.poa.validator_set.response
subjects.purpose: Return a signed PoA validator set or an unavailable reason.

subjects.subject: zap.pact.verify
subjects.purpose: Exchange offline PACT verification requests or results.

subjects.subject: zap.pact.bundle
subjects.purpose: Exchange portable PACT bundles for offline verification.

subjects.subject: zap.registry.index.request
subjects.purpose: Request a peer's ZapStore registry index.

subjects.subject: zap.registry.index.response
subjects.purpose: Return a registry index or an unavailable reason.

subjects.subject: zap.registry.bundle.manifest.request
subjects.purpose: Request a peer's ZapStore bundle manifest.

subjects.subject: zap.registry.bundle.manifest.response
subjects.purpose: Return a bundle manifest or an unavailable reason.

subjects.subject: zap.receipts.request
subjects.purpose: Request signed receipts from a peer receipt log.

subjects.subject: zap.receipts.response
subjects.purpose: Return verified signed receipts, with a truncation flag.
